description: OYH FPO pre-applied waterproofing membrane is a waterproof membrane composed of a Flexible polyolefin (FPO) sheet as the main material, a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer, a granule-faced bondin layer (except in the lap joint area), and separation material where required. It is designed to bond with cast-in-place concrete, installed using the pre-applied method, and its lap joints are sealed by hot-air welding. No additional layer is required, and in some cases no protective layer is needed.
whereToUse: Damp-proofing, waterproofing, and concrete protection in basements and other below-grade concrete structures
Cast-in-place reinforced concrete structures on site
advantages: Hot air welding: lap joints are hot-air welded, which has high peeling strength and forms a safe and reliable sealing waterproof layer

Made of thermoplastic polyolefin sheet and synthetic polymer adhesive, so it has high tensile strength, large elongation, impact resistance, tear resistance, chemical corrosion resistance, size stability under thermal aging
Excellent chemical corrosion resistance: resistance to acid, alkali, salt, algae, mold and other microbial corrosion
Strong bonding with concrete: It forms permanent bonding with post-cast concrete, which is not affected by foundation settlement and deformation
Construction can be conducted all over the year
Environmentally friendly: there is no solvent and harmful additives in the formula of thermoplastic polyolefin sheet and polymer self-adhesive layer
notFor: Hot-air welding should be conducted above -10℃
The welding surface must be wiped clean, without water, oil and dirt
All operators must be trained before work
personnel with spikes are strictly prohibited from entering the construction site where FPO membrane have been laid
After the construction of pre-applied FPO membrane on planar surface, it is advisable to cast the concrete within 28 days

technicalData.label: Shelf life
technicalData.value: the shelf life is one year from the date of production

mixing: Membrane can be directly laid on ‘not fully cured concrete’ or damp substrates without standing water, but the substrate should be smooth, solid, and free of obvious water accumulation.
storage: Avoid sun and rain. Pay attention to ventilation. Storage temperature should not be higher than 45 ℃.
